passage:
Dear Sandra and Tom,

I just heard from Marcus that you are both moving to Calgary next month for Sandra's new position at Evergreen Environmental Services. I have to say, I wasn't completely surprised — I know how long you've been hoping for an opportunity like this, Sandra — but it still feels a little strange to think that you won't be just a short drive away anymore. Calgary is a big move from here in Kelowna, and I imagine you're both feeling a mix of excitement and nerves right now.

I completely understand why you have to go, though. A senior project manager role at a firm like that doesn't come along every day, and from what Marcus told me, the salary and benefits package they've offered you is really quite generous. Tom, I know it wasn't the easiest decision for you either, especially with your landscaping business still going strong here. Closing up something you've spent years building takes real courage, and I respect that you're supporting Sandra through this. Hopefully the Calgary market will be welcoming to a new venture, whenever you're ready to start something up again.

Kevin and I want you to know that we'd like to help in any way we can before you leave. We have a fairly large van that we've lent out to friends before, so if you need extra space for moving boxes or furniture, please just say the word. We're also happy to take care of your cat, Pumpkin, while you're getting settled in those first few weeks — we know how stressful it can be to move a pet across provinces, and she's always welcome here. Our kids absolutely adore her, so it wouldn't be any trouble at all.

On a more personal note, the four of us have been friends since our university days, and that's not something that changes with distance. We're already thinking about planning a visit to Calgary sometime in the late spring. Kevin has never seen the Rockies up close, and honestly, neither have I. It would be wonderful to see your new home and explore a little of the city together.

Please don't feel like you have to handle everything on your own in the weeks ahead. Moving is overwhelming even under the best circumstances, and we're here if you need anything — whether it's help packing, someone to talk to, or even just a home-cooked meal before the big day. Reach out whenever you like.

Wishing you both all the best as you start this new chapter.

Warmly,
Linda

delay their trip to settle the business
